Definition: Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam
BiblicalUsage: Beor means "burning." The name is shared by several bearers: The father of Balaam; The father of Bela, king of Edom. It turns up in Genesis 36:32, Numbers 22:5 and Numbers 24:3.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Beor is worth remembering, even when little else is told — God counts His people one by one.
